plugins.name: claude-office
plugins.description: A live 3D office for your Claude Code sessions. Sessions and subagents walk in, take a desk, work while a tool runs, break for coffee when control comes back to you, and leave when they finish — driven by what is actually happening in ~/.claude. Click anyone to read their transcript. Ships prebuilt, so /panel runs with no install step.
